subject: Charged twice for my subscription
description: I was charged $29.99 twice this month for the same Pro plan subscription. This is the second time this has happened and I need a refund for the duplicate charge immediately.

subject: Can't log into my account
description: I've tried resetting my password three times but the reset email never arrives. I checked spam too. I have an important presentation tomorrow and need access today.

subject: Feature request: dark mode
description: Would love to see a dark mode option in the mobile app. Using it at night is pretty rough on the eyes right now. Not urgent, just a nice-to-have!

subject: App crashes when exporting reports

subject: Package never arrived

subject: Question about enterprise pricing
description: Hi, we're a team of about 40 people looking to upgrade from the team plan to enterprise. Could you send over pricing details and what's included?

subject: Thank you for the quick fix
description: Just wanted to say the bug I reported last week with the calendar sync got fixed super fast. Really appreciate the responsiveness, great support team!

subject: Want to cancel and get a refund
description: This product does not do what was advertised. I want a full refund and to cancel my account right now. If I don't hear back within 24 hours I'm disputing the charge with my bank.
